about: Its timers reach you with a card; set one to wake you if the phone will be face down.
name: A meeting you called

steps.about: As a question with a yes or a no in it. A meeting without one is a meeting that ends in another meeting.
steps.title: Write the decision you need

steps.about: And that nobody there only needs to hear it. Those people get the notes.
steps.title: Check everyone there can answer it

steps.about: Now, not in the invite three minutes before. Reading it in the room is the meeting.
steps.title: Send what they need to read

steps.about: Same day. A decision nobody wrote down was a discussion.
steps.title: Send the decision and who owns what
